checks_run.expected: The marker is understood, and after the re-save the rule still excludes S. The screen never states something the stored rule does not do.

checks_run.procedure: Judge the open question D-224 (3), whether an export with no 'Includes restricted records' label misleads a report reader. Read ADR-0051 lines 79 and 307, D-195 Q3, D-199 and restricted.ts. Check that the A12-4 export refusal and the A15 reporting journeys pass in EN and AR (DOM-R8-09, DOM-R8-10).
checks_run.command: grep -n export docs/architecture/adr/ADR-0051-*.md; sed -n 1,130p apps/api/src/modules/reporting/reports/restricted.ts; grep -n -i sensitiv docs/source/master-prompt.anchored.md; e2e runs in DOM-R8-09/10
checks_run.expected: No export leaks restricted content, and none states something untrue about what it contains
checks_run.actual: Not a defect, so no finding. Aggregates are computed identically for every reader (D-195 Q3, a user decision), so the exported figure is the true figure. Exports that would include a restricted record are refused (D-199; A12-4 passes in EN and AR), and the D-218 redaction omits restricted rows. So the file does not name what it omits, and it states no false figure. The screen label is an aid to the reader. The master prompt's scope clause (M0188 §10: access scoped by organization, business unit, transformation and sensitive record) does not require the label in a rendered file. The remaining gap is that a reader of the exported file is not told that a total includes values they cannot itemise. ADR-0051 records this as an open design question for a business owner. I recommend a footnote, but it is not a defect against an acceptance text. The restricted marker in automation conditions is understandable as such in EN and AR (DOM-R8-07). Its defect is integrity on re-save, not wording.

The residual commit-order race is documented in ADR-0043, and it can only run an action that a person already enabled, never an approval, since automations never decide approvals or gates (shown on the rule screen). summary: FAIL. F-DG6-460 (Low) is CLOSED_VERIFIED: ADR-0051, ADR-0045, OpenAPI, the data dictionary and the ERD now state the aggregate rule and cover migration 0126. New finding F-DG6-520 (Medium, REQ-S10-002): the D-222 (2) re-save rule pairs restricted markers by ordinal and position. When a rule author removes an earlier condition or an open list element, the hidden benefit id is replaced by the stored text '[restricted]'. That silently changes what the draft rule matches (a 'neq S' exclusion now matches S), while the editor still shows 'Includes restricted records' and 'is not a restricted record' in EN and AR.
